name: Stella Coral
source:
Motherly doctor. She is a quiet, mature woman and is married.
She has a gentle nature and is very sincere with everyone. She is an excellent ship's doctor, not only for physical injuries but also for mental care.

She has high hopes for our hero because he is the newly arrived vice-captain of the ship.

Her husband is also a soldier, and although they work in different departments, they are on the same ship.
She wants to have a child, and although they have been having a reasonable amount of sex, she has not been able to conceive.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/23774#product-character]official website[/url]]
